name: @wxyc/artwork-provenance-remediation
description: WXYC one-shot drain (BS#2258): re-resolve album_metadata.artwork_url for rows whose stored artwork is provably a Discogs artist image or label logo rather than a release cover. Complement of flowsheet-artwork-repair (BS#1209), which could only reach the rows the same LML bug left NULL. Positive-match selector via @wxyc/metadata's provenance decoder; narrow artwork_url-only write behind an exact-value race guard; never nulls a row out.
